facts.fact: The World Bank-financed Niger Smart Villages for rural growth and digital inclusion project (P167543), run with the government, aims to increase access to cellphone and broadband services in rural areas, with closing date 23 October 2026.
facts.system: Smart Villages for rural growth and digital inclusion (P167543)

facts.fact: The World Bank report says the Smart Villages project had provided mobile broadband to 780 villages previously without coverage as of 6 August 2025, 35.86 per cent of 2,175 planned.
